Arrange four blocks side by side across the canvas, from left to right.
Far left: six portraits in a two-column, three-row grid. Read each row from left to right.
Top row: Front portrait, complete head and shoulders. Profile portrait facing image-right, complete head and shoulders.
Middle row: Profile portrait facing image-left, complete head and shoulders. Three-quarter portrait facing image-right, complete head and shoulders.
Bottom row: Three-quarter portrait facing image-left, complete head and shoulders. Portrait from behind, complete head and shoulders.
Center: three full-body figures side by side, equally tall, with a small margin above and below.
From left to right: Full body facing forward, standing, complete figure visible. Full body in profile facing image-right, standing, complete figure visible. Full body from behind, standing, complete figure visible.
To their right: two flat outfit views side by side, front on the left and back on the right.
Extract the front of the outfit onto a white background. No human. The outfit is flat. Extract the back of the outfit onto a white background. No human. The outfit is flat.
Far right: hands above footwear. Top: Close-up of both hands, including their coverings when present in the reference. Bottom: Close-up of both feet and their footwear when present in the reference.
